Class Structure

java.lang.Object
Structure
Direct Known Subclasses:
Border, Exit, Heat, Spawn, Spike, Wall, Water
public abstract class Structure extends Object
Represents a structures on tiles during gameplay.

Contains the shared characteristics and behaviors between different structures. Different types of structures share display and Position information, differing on effects on interaction.

  • Method Details

    • interact

      public abstract boolean interact(Floor floor)
      Processes what happens if the Player interacts with the structure.

      Each subclass of structure must define their own interaction.

      Parameters:
      floor - the Floor the structure is on.
      Returns:
      true if the structure is destroyed as a result of the interaction, this is read by the Floor interact method which processes the destruction.

    • isBlocking

      public abstract boolean isBlocking(Floor floor)
      Checks if the structure would block the Player from moving.

      Each subclass of structure must define this and their conditions to allow or disallow it.

      Parameters:
      floor - the Floor the structure is on.
      Returns:
      true if the structure blocks the player from moving.

    • idle

      public abstract boolean idle(Floor floor)
      Processes what happens if the Player idles on top of the structure.

      Each subclass of structure must define what occurs.

      Parameters:
      floor - the Floor the structure is on.
      Returns:
      true if the structure is destroyed as a result of the idling, this is read by the Floor idle method which processes the destruction.
